# `matter/fluid/AdaptiveSphGpuNumericBounds.js`

> **Source:** `engine/matter/fluid/AdaptiveSphGpuNumericBounds.js`

Conservative f32 admission bounds for the non-authoritative GPU SPH operator.

## Functions

### `admitAdaptiveSphGpuNumericBounds({ packets, interactions, dtSeconds, gravityMPerS2, viscosity, pressureScale, surfaceTensionNPerM, bounds, kernelProfile, })`

Rejects inputs whose conservative shader-operation envelope can leave the normal finite f32 domain. It derives bounds only; density and forces remain GPU work and this receipt grants no simulation authority.

## Constants

- `ADAPTIVE_SPH_GPU_NUMERIC_BOUNDS_SCHEMA`
- `ADAPTIVE_SPH_GPU_NUMERIC_BOUNDS_VERSION`
